questions.question: LangGraph store 的 namespace 与 key 分别类似什么？文档是否只允许按 thread ID 组织长期记忆？
cannot_infer: 不能把文档、配置或静态代码描述称为实际运行验证，也不能推广成其他框架的保证。

points.answer: namespace类似文件夹、key类似文件名，可用用户或组织ID等自定义组织，不限thread ID。

supports.quote: LangGraph stores long-term memories as JSON documents in a [store](/oss/langgraph/stores). Each memory is organized under a custom `namespace` (similar to a folder) and a distinct `key` (like a file name). Namespaces often include user or org IDs or other labels that makes it easier to organize information. This structure enables hierarchical organization of memories. Cross-namespace searching is then supported through content filters.
supports.rationale: Source-first code-assistant annotation; no retrieval ranking or generated answer used; not human approval

supports.quote:
* [Short-term memory](#short-term-memory), or [thread](/oss/langgraph/checkpointers#threads)-scoped memory, tracks the ongoing conversation by maintaining message history within a session. LangGraph manages short-term memory as a part of your agent's [state](/oss/langgraph/graph-api#state). State is persisted to a database using a [checkpointer](/oss/langgraph/checkpointers#checkpoints) so the thread can be resumed at any time. Short-term memory updates when the graph is invoked or a step is completed, and the State is read at the start of each step.
* [Long-term memory](#long-term-memory) stores user-specific or application-level data across sessions and is shared _across_ conversational threads. It can be recalled _at any time_ and _in any thread_. Memories are scoped to any custom namespace, not just within a single thread ID. LangGraph provides [stores](/oss/langgraph/stores) ([reference doc](https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/reference/store/#langgraph.store.base.BaseStore)) to let you save and recall long-term memories.
